steps.title: Welcome to DJ Engine
steps.text: You're the DJ. Each gig, you play sets of CDs to win over the crowd. Reach the target score of {target} within {turns} turns to win the gig.

steps.title: Your score
steps.text: Every set you play adds to your score. The meter fills as you close in on the target.

steps.title: Cash
steps.text: Cash buys CDs, Stomp Boxes and cassettes. You earn more each turn and for every gig you win.

steps.title: The stall
steps.text: Each turn opens at the stall. Its stock changes every turn, so check it before you play.

steps.title: Stomp Boxes
steps.text: Stomp Boxes are your long-term investment. Once installed, they stay for the whole run and fire every set. Hold the {gear} to buy it, then click a bay to install it.

steps.title: Your rack
steps.text:
Most Stomp Boxes work on the tray right below their bay. {gear}: {gear_text}
Stomp Boxes are locked in place, so choose bays with care. Over a run, buy CDs that feed the Stomp Boxes you own.

steps.title: Cassettes
steps.text: Cassettes are one-shot items. Some boost the current turn, others change a CD for good. Hold {tape} to buy it.

steps.title: The cassette deck
steps.text:
{tape}: {tape_text}
Cassettes wait in your deck until you use them. We'll use this one after your first set.

steps.title: Done shopping
steps.text: Press Next Set to close the stall and open your hand.

steps.title: Your hand
steps.text: These are the CDs you drew. Each turn you play up to {max_play} of them as a set.

steps.title: Reading a CD
steps.text: The green badge is the CD's base points. The note under the cover is its ability: when it triggers and what it gives. Hover any CD to see the full details.

steps.title: Genre traits
steps.text:
Every CD has a genre, shown by its colour and the sticker on its cover. Each genre has a trait that earns flow.
{genre} · {trait_name}: {trait}

steps.title: Points x flow
steps.text: As songs play they add points. Flow multiplies them. A set scores points x flow, so lining up traits and abilities is how big scores happen.

steps.title: Build a set
steps.text: Drag or click a CD in your hand to put it in a tray. Trays play in order, left to right.

steps.title: Play the set
steps.text: Add more CDs if you like. Order matters for abilities and traits. When you're ready, press Play.

steps.title: Nice set
steps.text: Your set's points x flow went onto your score. A new turn starts with a fresh stall and new CDs in your hand.

steps.title: Over to you
steps.text: Finish the gig on your own. Press Next Set, build a set and press Play. If your hand is weak, Discard swaps it for new CDs ({discards} times per gig).

steps.title: Gig complete
steps.text: A full run is a tour of gigs with shops and pickups between them, and a headliner boss every few gigs. That's everything you need to start.
